## Checklist

- [ ] Uses only official platform APIs. No browser automation, scraping or unofficial clients for posting.
- [ ] Any publishing path goes through a human approval checkpoint.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or keys in code, tests, fixtures or logs.
- [ ] New platform skills include `references/setup.md`.
- [ ] `npm run build` was run and the generated `skills/*/scripts/*.mjs` files are committed.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
